body.en: North-east of the oasis at the city of Al-Omran, close to Al-Qarah Mountain, spreads Al-Ahsa National Park — a story that began in 1382 AH / 1962 CE as a Ministry of Agriculture project to hold back the sands creeping over the oasis villages. Millions of trees were planted, most of them tamarisk, over an area of some 4,500 hectares with a belt running twenty kilometres, and over time the sand barriers grew into a lush man-made forest, then a public park with shaded seating, trails and family facilities. Today it is overseen by the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, which continues its rehabilitation projects, and within its bounds the Jawatha Forest was launched with two million trees of salt-tolerant native species.

ru.title: Национальный парк Аль-Ахсы
ru.summary: Рукотворный лес, выросший из проекта 1962 года по сдерживанию песков: миллионы тамарисков, навесы и дорожки.
ru.body: К северо-востоку от оазиса, у города Эль-Умран и неподалёку от горы Эль-Кара, раскинулся Национальный парк Аль-Ахсы. Его история началась в 1382 году хиджры (1962 год н. э.), когда Министерство сельского хозяйства взялось за проект по сдерживанию песков, наступавших на деревни оазиса. Здесь высадили миллионы деревьев, в основном тамарисков, на площади около 4 500 га. Пояс насаждений протянулся на двадцать километров. Со временем песчаные заслоны превратились в густой рукотворный лес, а затем и в общественный парк — с навесами, дорожками и местами для семейного отдыха. Сегодня за парк отвечает Национальный центр развития растительного покрова и борьбы с опустыниванием, который продолжает восстановительные работы. В границах парка заложили лес Джавата — два миллиона деревьев местных пород, устойчивых к засолению.

de.title: Al-Ahsa-Nationalpark
de.summary: Ein künstlich angelegter Wald, hervorgegangen aus einem Projekt zur Sandeindämmung von 1962 – Millionen Tamarisken, Schattendächer und Wege.
de.body: Nordöstlich der Oase, bei der Stadt Al-Omran und unweit des Jabal al-Qarah (des Qarah-Bergs), erstreckt sich der Al-Ahsa-Nationalpark. Seine Geschichte begann 1382 nach der Hidschra (1962 n. Chr.) als Projekt, mit dem das Landwirtschaftsministerium die Dörfer der Oase vor dem vordringenden Sand schützen wollte. Auf einer Fläche von rund 4.500 Hektar wurden Millionen Bäume gepflanzt, überwiegend Tamarisken; ein Gürtel zieht sich über zwanzig Kilometer. Mit der Zeit wuchsen die Sandbarrieren zu einem üppigen, künstlich angelegten Wald heran. Später wurde daraus ein öffentlicher Park mit Schattendächern, Wegen und Einrichtungen für Familien. Heute steht der Park unter der Aufsicht des Nationalen Zentrums für die Entwicklung der Vegetationsdecke und die Bekämpfung der Wüstenbildung, das die Projekte zu seiner Wiederherstellung fortführt. In den Grenzen des Parks wurde der Jawatha-Wald mit zwei Millionen Bäumen heimischer, salztoleranter Arten ins Leben gerufen.

zh.title: 哈萨国家公园
zh.summary: 这片人工林源于 1962 年的固沙工程，栽有数百万棵柽柳，林间设有遮阳凉棚与步道。
zh.body: 哈萨国家公园（Al-Ahsa National Park）位于绿洲东北部的欧姆兰市，距卡拉山不远。公园的由来可追溯到伊斯兰历 1382 年（公元 1962 年）：那一年，沙特农业部启动了一项固沙工程，以保护绿洲村庄免受流沙侵袭。工程栽下了数百万棵树，以柽柳为主，造林面积约 4500 公顷，防护林带绵延 20 公里。随着时间推移，这些防沙屏障渐渐长成一片葱郁的人工林，继而辟为公共公园，设有遮阳凉棚、步道与家庭休闲设施。如今，公园由沙特国家植被发展与荒漠化防治中心负责管理，该中心至今仍在推进园区的修复项目。园区范围内还启动了贾瓦塔森林项目，栽种耐盐本地树木 200 万棵。

It is the kicker of king-abdullah-park, approved in b6: the Urdu is copied byte for byte from the translation memory (the pair is keyed by its Arabic, since there is no English kicker), ONE string on the six pages. Ruling N69 and the termbase: a park (منتزه) is ONE Urdu noun, the termbase key, feminine; the loan stays out (ruling P16). king-abdullah-park (b6) is the only approved park page, and the approved jawatha-mosque page calls a park by the same noun: read both before choosing a word of the park vocabulary (DECISIONS, b7).

summary.note: Shown under the h1, as the meta description of the Urdu page (no answer_ur exists), on index cards and in JSON-LD.

body.en: West of Al-Mubarraz lies Ain Najm Park, a public park laid out by Al-Ahsa Municipality around the historic Ain Najm — one of Al-Ahsa's most famous hot sulphur springs, sought since old times for its healing waters, and described as the Kingdom's first tourist site devoted to healing and wellness. Its buildings, with their distinctive half-oval domes, were raised in 1115 AH / 1703 CE, and the spring is woven into the region's history: beside it the people of Al-Ahsa pledged allegiance to Saud bin Abdulaziz (later Imam) in 1799, and King Abdulaziz came to take its waters in 1367 AH / 1948 CE. After redevelopment, the park welcomed visitors in mid-2015 with greenery and quiet family sittings, and it is managed today by Al-Ahsa Municipality.

ru.body: К западу от Эль-Мубарраза лежит общественный парк Айн-Наджм (в переводе — источник Наджм). Муниципалитет Аль-Ахсы разбил его вокруг исторического Айн-Наджм — одного из самых известных горячих серных источников Аль-Ахсы. За целебной водой сюда приходили с давних пор. Источник называют первым туристическим объектом Королевства, посвящённым лечению. Постройки с приметными полуовальными куполами возвели в 1115 году хиджры (1703 год н. э.). Сам источник вплетён в историю края: возле него в 1799 году жители Аль-Ахсы присягнули Сауду ибн Абдул-Азизу (впоследствии имаму), а в 1367 г. х. (1948 г. н. э.) сюда приезжал лечиться водами король Абдул-Азиз. После обновления парк принял посетителей в середине 2015 года — здесь зелень и тихие площадки для семейного отдыха. Сегодня им управляет муниципалитет Аль-Ахсы.

de.title: Ain-Najm-Park
de.summary: Ein Park rund um die historische Quelle Ain Najm westlich von Al-Mubarraz – die bekannteste der Schwefelquellen Al-Ahsas, die zur Heilung aufgesucht werden.
de.body: Westlich von Al-Mubarraz liegt der Ain-Najm-Park, eine öffentliche Anlage rund um die historische Quelle Ain Najm (die Najm-Quelle). Angelegt hat ihn die Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa. Ain Najm zählt zu den bekanntesten heißen Schwefelquellen Al-Ahsas: Schon seit alter Zeit kommen Menschen hierher, um mit ihrem Wasser Heilung zu suchen. Die Quelle wird als erste touristische Stätte im Königreich beschrieben, die der Heilung gewidmet ist. Ihre Bauten mit den markanten halbovalen Kuppeln entstanden 1115 nach der Hidschra (n. H.; 1703 n. Chr.). Mit der Geschichte der Region ist sie verwoben: An ihr leisteten die Bewohner von Al-Ahsa im Jahr 1799 den Treueid auf Saud bin Abdulaziz, den späteren Imam, und König Abdulaziz suchte sie 1367 n. H. (1948 n. Chr.) auf, um sich mit ihrem Wasser behandeln zu lassen. Nach dem Ausbau empfing der Park Mitte 2015 seine Besucher – mit Grün und ruhigen Sitzplätzen für Familien. Heute führt ihn die Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa.

zh.title: 艾因奈杰姆公园
zh.summary: 艾因奈杰姆公园位于穆巴拉兹以西，环绕历史悠久的艾因奈杰姆泉而建；这眼泉是哈萨最负盛名的硫磺疗养泉。
zh.body: 艾因奈杰姆公园（Ain Najm Park）位于穆巴拉兹以西，是哈萨市政局修建并管理的一座公共公园，环绕着历史悠久的艾因奈杰姆泉（“艾因”即阿拉伯语“泉”）。这眼泉是哈萨最负盛名的硫磺温泉之一，自古便有人专程来此泡泉疗养，因此人们称它为沙特阿拉伯第一处专为疗养而设的旅游景点。泉畔的建筑建于伊斯兰历 1115 年（公元 1703 年），以别具一格的半椭圆形穹顶著称。艾因奈杰姆泉还见证了本地区历史上的几个重要时刻：1799 年，当地居民在此向后来成为伊玛目的沙特·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹宣誓效忠；近一个半世纪后的伊历 1367 年（公元 1948 年），阿卜杜勒阿齐兹国王亦曾亲临此地，借泉水疗疾。公园经改造后，于 2015 年中期向游客开放，园内绿意盎然，辟有清静的家庭休憩区。

body.en: Near Al-Qarah village on the eastern side of the oasis spreads Al-Mushaqar Park (formerly Al-Shaibani Park), a green retreat of dense plantings with open lawns, a folk souq and family play areas. The place carries the name of the famed pre-Islamic Mushaqar fortress — known in early Arabic sources as the 'fort of Hajar', mentioned in the accounts of Arabia's celebrated battle-days and neighbour to the Mushaqar market, one of the pre-Islamic Arab fairs — though scholars still debate the original fort's location between Al-Battaliyah, Jawatha and Al-Qarah. At the park's heart stands the 'Mushaqar Palace', a modern building raised in homage to that ancient stronghold, now the park's centrepiece and icon.

ru.title: Парк Эш-Шайбани / Эль-Мушаккар
ru.summary: Обширный парк близ деревни Эль-Кара носит имя доисламской крепости Эль-Мушаккар, а в его сердце стоит дворец, построенный в память о ней.
ru.body: Близ деревни Эль-Кара, на восточной стороне оазиса, раскинулся парк Эль-Мушаккар (прежде — парк Эш-Шайбани): густые посадки, открытые лужайки, народный рынок и игровые площадки для всей семьи. Место носит имя прославленной доисламской крепости Эль-Мушаккар — ранние арабские источники знали её как «крепость Хаджар». Её упоминают предания о знаменитых битвах арабов, а поблизости проходила ярмарка Эль-Мушаккар — одна из доисламских арабских ярмарок. Впрочем, о том, где стояла первоначальная крепость, исследователи спорят до сих пор: Эль-Батталия, Джавата или Эль-Кара. В сердце парка стоит «Дворец Эль-Мушаккар» — современное здание, возведённое в память о той древней крепости. Сегодня это лицо парка и его символ.

de.title: Al-Shaibani-/Al-Mushaqar-Park
de.summary: Ein weitläufiger Park nahe dem Dorf Al-Qarah: Er trägt den Namen der vorislamischen Festung Mushaqar, und in seinem Herzen steht ein Palast, der ihr nachempfunden ist.
de.body: Nahe dem Dorf Al-Qarah, an der Ostseite der Oase, erstreckt sich der Al-Mushaqar-Park (früher Al-Shaibani-Park): ein weitläufiger grüner Rückzugsort inmitten dichter Pflanzungen, mit offenen Grünflächen, einem Souk (traditioneller Markt) und Spielbereichen für Familien. Der Ort trägt den Namen der berühmten vorislamischen Festung Mushaqar, die in den frühen arabischen Quellen „Festung von Hajar“ heißt. Erwähnt wird sie in den Berichten über die Ayyam al-Arab (die Schlachttage der Araber). In der Nachbarschaft der Festung fand der Markt von Mushaqar statt, einer der Märkte der Araber aus vorislamischer Zeit. Wo die ursprüngliche Festung stand, ist in der Forschung bis heute umstritten: Al-Battaliyah, Jawatha oder Al-Qarah. Im Herzen des Parks steht der „Mushaqar-Palast“, ein moderner Bau, errichtet in Anlehnung an jene alte Festung – heute das Gesicht und das Wahrzeichen des Parks.

zh.title: 穆沙卡尔公园
zh.summary: 卡拉村附近的一座大型公园，得名于伊斯兰教兴起前的穆沙卡尔堡。园中心的“穆沙卡尔宫”便是以这座古堡为灵感建成的。
zh.body: 穆沙卡尔公园（Al-Mushaqar Park）旧称沙伊巴尼公园，位于绿洲东侧的卡拉村附近，是一座掩映在葱郁田园之中的大型公园，园内有开阔的绿地、一个民俗市集和几片家庭游乐区。公园得名于著名的穆沙卡尔堡。这座古堡可追溯至伊斯兰教兴起之前，古代阿拉伯文献称之为“哈杰尔堡”；穆沙卡尔堡之名既见于记述早期部落战事的“阿拉伯人的日子”（Ayyam al-Arab），也与古代阿拉伯人的集市传统有关：昔日的穆沙卡尔集市就设在堡垒附近，是那个时代阿拉伯人的集市之一。至于古堡原址究竟在巴塔利亚、贾瓦塔还是卡拉，学者们至今仍有争论。公园中心矗立着“穆沙卡尔宫”，这座现代建筑以古堡为灵感建成，如今已是公园的门面与标志。

No ruling words a title with two names, nor their order where title_en sets the former name first and both bodies the present one first: stage 1 follows title_en, proposes both names with gender and source, and stage 4 raises it (N101 onwards). The generic is the termbase key for a park (feminine). No bracket in a title (rulings P3a and P3c-labels).

Rulings P1 and P17: the name carries its article at EVERY mention — the park, the fort, the market and the palace — although the EN drops it in four of its five forms; the Arabic is the only source of the name's spelling. The former name likewise (الشيباني).

It is the kicker of king-abdullah-park, approved in b6: the Urdu is copied byte for byte from the translation memory (the pair is keyed by its Arabic, since there is no English kicker), ONE string on the six pages. The fort's second name is quoted by both sources (حصن هجر): a name the source itself sets in quotation marks stands in marks (rulings N40 and N72 each ruled one kind of quoted name; this one has a generic that translates and a place name that does not) — stage 1 proposes, stage 4 raises.

summary.en: The mountain park Al-Ahsa Municipality is building on the Shu'bah/Kanzan massif — mountain slides, suspended bridges and waterfalls.
summary.ar: المنتزه الجبلي الذي تنفذه أمانة الأحساء فوق كتلة الشعبة/كنزان — تزلج جبلي وجسور معلقة وشلالات.
summary.note: Shown under the h1, as the meta description of the Urdu page (no answer_ur exists), on index cards and in JSON-LD.

body.en: On the massif of Al-Shu'bah Mountain (historically Kanzan) north-east of the oasis, Al-Ahsa Municipality is building a large mountain recreation park in phases — the project is officially known as the Shu'bah Mountain Park. Partial operation of the upper section began in late 2022, with mountain slide arenas, artificial waterfalls running some 1,100 metres, three suspended wooden bridges, a zipline, children's play areas and walking paths. Announced elements of the project also include a 1,500-metre cable car with three stations and two lakes; the remaining construction phases are still under way, and full operation is yet to be confirmed.

ru.title: Парк горы Канзан (Эш-Шууба)
ru.summary: Горный парк, который муниципалитет Аль-Ахсы строит на массиве Эш-Шууба (или Канзан): горные спуски, подвесные мосты и водопады.
ru.body: К северо-востоку от оазиса, на массиве горы Эш-Шууба, муниципалитет Аль-Ахсы поэтапно строит большой горный парк отдыха. Эта гора носит историческое имя Канзан (по-арабски — Джабаль-Канзан), а сам проект официально называется «Парк горы Эш-Шууба». В конце 2022 года верхний участок парка заработал частично: здесь появились площадки для горных спусков, искусственные водопады протяжённостью около 1 100 метров, три подвесных деревянных моста, зиплайн, детские игровые площадки и пешеходные дорожки. Среди объявленных объектов проекта — канатная дорога длиной 1 500 метров с тремя станциями и два озера. Остальные этапы строительства ещё продолжаются, а о полном запуске парка информация уточняется.

de.title: Kanzan-Bergpark (Al-Shu'bah)
de.summary: Der Bergpark, den die Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa auf dem Massiv Al-Shu'bah/Kanzan baut – mit Rutschbahnen am Hang, Hängebrücken und Wasserfällen.
de.body: Nordöstlich der Oase, auf dem Massiv des Al-Shu'bah-Bergs (historisch Kanzan), baut die Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa in mehreren Bauabschnitten einen großen Bergpark zur Erholung; offiziell ist das Vorhaben als Al-Shu'bah-Bergpark bekannt. Der obere Bereich ging Ende 2022 teilweise in Betrieb – mit Flächen für Rutschbahnen am Hang, künstlichen Wasserfällen von rund 1.100 Metern Länge, drei hölzernen Hängebrücken, einer Seilrutsche, Spielbereichen für Kinder und Fußwegen. Zu den angekündigten Bestandteilen des Projekts gehören außerdem zwei Seen und eine 1.500 Meter lange Seilbahn mit drei Stationen. Die übrigen Bauabschnitte dauern an; Angaben werden noch bestätigt – zur vollständigen Inbetriebnahme des Parks.

zh.title: 坎赞山公园（舒阿巴）
zh.summary: 哈萨市政局正在舒阿巴山（史称坎赞山）上建设一座山地公园，项目包含山地滑道、悬索桥与瀑布。
zh.body: 舒阿巴山（Al-Shu'bah）史称坎赞山（Kanzan），位于绿洲东北部。哈萨市政局正在这座山上分期建设一座大型山地休闲公园，即坎赞山公园，其官方名称为“舒阿巴山公园”。公园上部区域的设施已于 2022 年底部分投入运营，包括山地滑道场地、总长约 1100 米的一组人工瀑布、三座木制悬索桥、一条滑索、儿童游乐区和步行道。项目已公布的规划还包括一条长 1500 米、设三个站点的缆车线路，以及两个湖泊。其余各期工程仍在推进中。

The Chinese and German lines say slides, the Russian 'mountain descents'.

The approved kanzan page says it from the other side ('the name the history books know it by, though today it is commonly called Al-Shu'bah Mountain') and ends with this very park: 'Al-Ahsa Municipality is developing a major recreational park on the massif'. This page's AR noun phrase is that page's with one adjective more, 'mountain' (منتزهاً ترفيهياً جبلياً كبيراً), and 'in phases' (على مراحل). 'Children's play areas' — AR 'children's rides' (وألعاب أطفال). 'A zipline' — AR 'the flying rope' (والحبل الطائر). The AR writes the cable car as a loanword.

body, last sentence: EN 'a 1,500-metre cable car with three stations and two lakes' — in the AR the two lakes are a second element of the project and not something the cable car has (بثلاث محطات وبحيرتان); the EN can be read either way. The Chinese, German and Russian lines set the lakes apart. A semicolon in the EN, a comma in the AR.

The German and Russian lines translated the clause; the Chinese line left it out. It is the site's own reservation written into a page's text, in other words than the sentence ruling N99 fixed ('Further details … are pending confirmation from reliable sources'): the two share the idea and no wording.

site_rules_that_bind_this_page: Invent nothing: no hours, fees, distances, dates, superlatives or tips the source does not carry.

Title: the EN and the AR differ on the name — 'Adventure Park' in the EN, 'Mountain Park' in the AR (منتزه جبل كنزان). Arabic is the only source of names (RUNBOOK, rule 4), and the Chinese, German and Russian titles follow it. The mountain is a termbase key and the approved title of the kanzan page: it stands byte for byte (DECISIONS, b7), with the termbase key for a park. Stage 1 proposes the title on ruling N43's pattern (the place name as its key, the Urdu possessive, the generic), records what it did with 'Adventure', and stage 4 raises the divergence as a new open item (N101 onwards).

THE BRACKET IN THE TITLE: both sources carry a second name in a bracket inside the title (الشعبة). Rulings P3a and P3c-labels and the stage checker allow no bracket in a title; no ruling words a title with a second name. Stage 1 reports what check-s1 says of the title and does not bend the text to the checker nor edit it (RUNBOOK); stage 4 raises the second name of a title as an open item with candidates; the judge rules. The bare name is spelled as the termbase's keys spell it (the village's key; the second word of the mountain's present-day key).

Kicker (DECISIONS; ruling P24): no English source, translated from the Arabic (منتزه). It is the kicker of king-abdullah-park, approved in b6: the Urdu is copied byte for byte from the translation memory (the pair is keyed by its Arabic, since there is no English kicker), ONE string on the six pages. No final stop, no gloss. Not rendered today.

Ruling N69 and the termbase: a park (منتزه) is ONE Urdu noun, the termbase key, feminine; the loan stays out (ruling P16). king-abdullah-park (b6) is the only approved park page, and the approved jawatha-mosque page calls a park by the same noun: read both before choosing a word of the park vocabulary (DECISIONS, b7). The approved kanzan page already says, of this very park, that the municipality is building it, with the park noun and with 'massif' in an approved wording: names and shared facts are taken from that page byte for byte, never re-derived (DECISIONS, b7).

Names (RUNBOOK, rule 2): the mountain's two names are two termbase keys — the name of the history books, and the present-day name (جبل الشعبة); the bare forms of the summary (كتلة الشعبة/كنزان) are spelled as those keys spell them. Al-Ahsa Municipality is the key of ruling N68: feminine agreement, no quotation marks, inflected. The official name of the project (منتزه جبل الشعبة) is named AS a name ('officially known as'): rulings N16 and N40 word names that are named as such; stage 1 proposes its form and stage 4 lists it. Ruling P3a's demand for the Urdu generic binds a page whose own title is a jabal name.

Ruling N47: the page mentions the oasis (the body's first sentence; the area line) and names it in no field: the Urdu names it at one of those mentions at least, in the termbase form of the Al-Ahsa Oasis; the bare noun may stand at the others. Not machine-read: a point for the proofreader. Site-wide build check C15 ('the largest oasis in the world') has no Urdu entry in its tables; this page carries no such claim and none is brought in. The approved kanzan summary has Urdu for 'north-east of the oasis' with the oasis named.

THE LAST CLAUSE of the English body, 'and full operation is yet to be confirmed', has no Arabic and is rendered text: the English is the translation source, so it is translated and not dropped because the Arabic lacks it (RUNBOOK, rule 4). It is NOT the sentence ruling N99 fixed — that ruling binds, letter for letter, the sentence 'Further details … are pending confirmation from reliable sources' — and it is not the short form of open item P4 (a card value or a tag, which is not to be worded before it is ruled; style rule pending_phrase). Stage 1 translates the clause faithfully, with the predicate of ruling N99 as the nearest approved wording to read first; nothing is promised (no date, no 'will open'); stage 4 raises it as a new open item. The site's Arabic phrase for this reservation is named in tools/check-consistency.mjs under C6 (بانتظار التأكيد), which compares card rows only: no build check reads this clause in any language.

Ruling N33, build check C65 (SEMICOLON in tools/check-ur-text.mjs; ALREADY TARGETS /ur/): no Arabic semicolon in an Urdu attraction page. The EN's last sentence has one (the AR has a comma): the Urdu ends the statement about the cable car and the lakes with a full stop or joins otherwise. Arabic is the authority that the two lakes are an element of the project and not of the cable car (بثلاث محطات وبحيرتان); a lake is the termbase key, feminine.

Ruling P16 with its test (P16-test) and the precedent of ruling N90: the zipline and the cable car. The AR has a native description for the first (والحبل الطائر) and a loanword for the second (تلفريك بمسار 1500 متر). No English loan where a common Urdu word exists; a loan enters only on the three conditions of the test, as a termbase entry with its evidence. Stage 1 verifies each on the web, proposes it as a term, and stage 4 raises both. 'Mountain slides' (تزلج جبلي): the Arabic word also means skiing; nothing on the page says snow, and the Urdu says sliding on a slope, as the EN does.

Numbers (rulings P10 and N24): 1,100 and 1,500 are below one lakh and keep the English grouping; the unit follows the figure; 'three' bridges, 'three' stations and 'two' lakes stay in words as the English has them; 'some' stands before 1,100 only, as in both sources. A part of a year ('late 2022', 'late 2020', 'mid-2015' — three pages of the batch): rulings N11 and N20 give the words for the early, middle and late part of a century and of a decade; no ruling words them for a single year. Stage 1 builds on those words, uses ONE form on kanzan-park, koot-park and najm-park, and stage 4 raises it (N101 onwards). A year the source gives in one calendar stays bare (ruling N12).

Area line (rulings P20 and N30): a place, then its position by the oasis, with no larger bare place: the Urdu keeps the source's order and ends in a postposition; the stage checker's note of ruling P20 is expected. The area line of the approved kanzan page is another line and is not copied.

Midnight is the figure 12 with its part of the day and no word for midnight beside it (ruling N9); the figure stands in the Arabic of the field, as the stage checker's number rule wants. The label 'Hours' has an approved pair and is reused verbatim. The value ends without a stop (ruling P26) and carries no U+061B (rulings N8 and N33).

Build checks C12 and C13 (tools/check-visit-card.mjs, run by tools/check-consistency.mjs): the page is NOT openSite and has verified Hours and Fees rows, so once a row carries label_ur and value_ur the unified hours-and-fees notice line must stand exactly once on the /ur/ page, in the interface's approved Urdu (det.hoursNotice with det.hoursNotice.op; the page has no operatorUrl, so no link). C13 ALREADY TARGETS Urdu: no pattern is to be added, and the notice is not a leaf of the pack. C12: 'Verified directly with Al-Ahsa Municipality' is internal data and is never rendered; there is no `source_ur` (ruling P14), and nothing of it enters a label, a value or the body.

Card rows (RUNBOOK, rule 3): the labels 'Hours' and 'Fees' and the value 'Free entry' have approved pairs in ur-translation/memory/tm.json and are reused verbatim. The page has no 'Visiting' row and none is supplied. The 'Open 24 hours' and 'Open public site' rows of the approved kanzan page are that page's and are not carried here.

Interface (src/i18n/ui.ts; not leaves of the pack): the page's category is nature, so its breadcrumb and back link are the attractions ones (crumb.attractions, det.allSights) and its category label is CATEGORY_LABELS.nature — all approved Urdu. The Urdu block lacks three ids the detail template reads (site.brand, det.openAmap, det.mentions.h); none is printed on this page today.

Root CLAUDE.md: invent nothing — no date for the full opening, no price or age limit for a ride, no height, no length for the bridges or the zipline, no number of slides or waterfalls, no statement that the cable car or the lakes exist today (they are 'announced elements'). summary.en: A municipal garden in historic central Hofuf, part of the 'humanising cities' programme, steps from Qasr Ibrahim.
summary.ar: حديقة بلدية وسط الهفوف التاريخي، من حدائق مشروع «أنسنة المدن» على خطوات من قصر إبراهيم.

body.en: In the heart of the Al-Koot district in historic central Hofuf, steps away from Qasr Ibrahim and the Qaisariyah Souq, lies Al-Koot Park, a municipal garden Al-Ahsa Municipality dedicated in late 2020 as one of eight gardens under its 'humanising cities' programme. The garden offers water fountains, trees and lawns, a shaded children's play area, walking space and public conveniences, with accessibility for people with disabilities taken into account. It also falls within the wider set of projects to develop historic central Hofuf, where the district's gardens are being styled with Hasawi architectural motifs — making it a natural pause between the quarter's heritage landmarks.

ru.title: Парк Эль-Кут
ru.summary: Городской сад в историческом центре Эль-Хуфуфа, в нескольких шагах от крепости Каср-Ибрахим — один из садов программы «Гуманизация городов».
ru.body: В сердце района Эль-Кут, в историческом центре Эль-Хуфуфа, разбит парк Эль-Кут — городской сад в нескольких шагах от крепости Каср-Ибрахим и рынка Эль-Кайсария. Муниципалитет Аль-Ахсы открыл его в конце 2020 года как один из восьми садов своей программы «Гуманизация городов». Здесь фонтаны, деревья и газоны, затенённая детская площадка, дорожки для прогулок и общественные туалеты; при обустройстве учли потребности людей с инвалидностью. Сад входит и в более широкий ряд проектов по развитию исторического центра Эль-Хуфуфа, где сады района оформляют архитектурными мотивами Аль-Ахсы, — и становится естественной передышкой между здешними историческими памятниками.

de.title: Al-Koot-Park
de.summary: Ein kommunaler Garten im historischen Zentrum von Hofuf, nur wenige Schritte von Qasr Ibrahim entfernt – Teil des Programms „Humanisierung der Städte“.
de.body: Im Herzen des Al-Koot-Viertels im historischen Zentrum von Hofuf liegt der Al-Koot-Park, ein kommunaler Garten nur wenige Schritte von Qasr Ibrahim (dem Ibrahim-Palast) und vom Qaisariyah-Souk entfernt. Ende 2020 weihte ihn die Kommunalverwaltung von Al-Ahsa ein – als einen von acht Gärten ihres Programms „Humanisierung der Städte“. Der Garten bietet einen schattigen Spielbereich für Kinder, Spazierwege und öffentliche Toiletten sowie Springbrunnen, Bäume und Rasenflächen; die Bedürfnisse von Menschen mit Behinderung wurden dabei berücksichtigt. Er gehört zugleich zu den größer angelegten Projekten zur Entwicklung der historischen Innenstadt von Hofuf, in deren Rahmen die Gärten des Viertels architektonische Motive aus Al-Ahsa erhalten. So wird der Park zu einer natürlichen Pause zwischen den Sehenswürdigkeiten, die zum kulturellen Erbe des Viertels gehören.

zh.title: 库特公园
zh.summary: 胡富夫历史城区的一座市政公园，距易卜拉欣宫仅几步之遥，是“城市人性化”项目所建公园之一。
zh.body: 库特公园（Al-Koot Park）是一座市政公园，位于胡富夫历史城区，坐落在库特区的中心地带，离易卜拉欣宫和凯撒利亚集市只有几步路。公园由哈萨市政局于 2020 年底揭幕启用，是“城市人性化”项目所建八座公园之一。园内有喷泉、树木和草坪，还有一片阴凉的儿童游乐区、步行道和公共卫生间，并兼顾了残障人士的无障碍需求。公园也是胡富夫历史城区整体开发项目的一部分，街区内的各座公园正融入哈萨建筑元素，这也使它自然而然地成为老城各处遗产地标之间的一处歇脚处。

The termbase has both nouns as keys of different gender: the key for a park (feminine, ruling N69) and the key for a garden (masculine), whose entry says it is not the key for a park.
